historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly denies remote visual substitution but overlooks the automatable state timeline and treats blink frequency as an unaudited human impression.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly defines a one-cycle hybrid test with workload drain, synchronized visual capture and recovery.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code/source search found no earlier V3.1 record for this identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The 1 Hz and 4 Hz phases are temporal signals, so still photographs cannot prove them. Video frame timing must cover enough complete cycles and be synchronized to distinct BMC-ready, POST and OS-ready milestones; otherwise stage transition or camera aliasing can misclassify the blink rate.

original_test_intent: Verify that the physical system power indicator follows the specified green LED state and blink-frequency sequence across AC removal, BMC startup, POST and OS boot.
original_method: Pin the LED location, power-restore policy and milestone definitions, drain workloads, use an authorized operator to remove/restore AC once, capture synchronized high-frame-rate video and independent BMC/console/OS timestamps, calculate OFF/1 Hz/4 Hz/solid intervals with approved tolerance, and stop without repeating the cycle on unsafe power or recovery failure.
manual_activity: An authorized operator performs one approved AC removal/restore and records the physical LED; the owner approves blink tolerances, auto-power behavior and stage milestones and decides the verdict.
safety_requirements: Use authorized cable handling and safe AC isolation
Agent must not manipulate power cables
Stop on boot loop, unexpected power state or recovery timeout
Use video capable of resolving 4 Hz without aliasing
agent_execution_scope: Timestamp AC and boot transitions reported by the operator
Correlate LED intervals with BMC/POST/OS milestones
engineer_actions: Authorize workload drain and AC cycle

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Physical observation is mandatory, but a generic NO omits safe AC handling, quantitative 1/4 Hz measurement and available automated milestone correlation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Have an authorized operator perform one approved AC removal/restore while recording synchronized video; correlate measured LED state/frequency with read-only BMC, POST and OS milestones.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OFF, 1 Hz, 4 Hz and solid-green sequence and 20-minute activity remain; frequency tolerance and stage evidence are made auditable.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a timeline containing AC state, BMC readiness, POST, OS readiness, LED color, measured period/duty cycle and confidence for every stage.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces subjective blink observation with time-based measurement synchronized to the system state machine.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Still images or unsynchronized observation can show green but cannot prove 1 Hz versus 4 Hz or that each rate occurred in the intended boot phase.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure and frame rate can alias a 4 Hz signal; the capture setup and minimum cycle count must be approved before the AC action.

project_override_considerations: Define accepted green color reference, blink frequency and duty-cycle tolerance, minimum observed cycles, camera frame rate, exact BMC/POST/OS transition anchors, auto-power behavior and maximum recovery time.
expected_evidence: Workload drain, operator and AC/ESD evidence
Synchronized raw video with LED/AC visibility
Calculated OFF/1 Hz/4 Hz/solid timeline tied to BMC/POST/OS events
Preserved logs, recovery, no-repeat/no-policy-change audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define the power-indicator sequence. Duplicate step numbering and less-detailed Criteria do not contradict the explicit 1 Hz/4 Hz Procedure.

blocked_analysis.analysis: LED tolerances, operator, power procedure and visual/time evidence are obtainable. Execution becomes BLOCKED if safe AC control or a capture setup capable of resolving the required rates is unavailable.

review_improvement: Makes the physical LED sequence quantitatively measurable and synchronized to boot-state evidence while limiting the disruptive AC stimulus to one approved cycle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Blink frequency is a waveform property, not a static color state. Proving the intended controller state machine requires multiple measured cycles aligned to BMC, POST and OS transitions; otherwise a transient phase, camera alias or late observation can satisfy the qualitative wording without covering the specified behavior.
